h1: Turnkey custom kitchens in Bratislava — design, manufacturing, and installation

blocks.text: Turnkey custom kitchens in Bratislava — design, manufacturing, and installation

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is a design studio and furniture manufacturer in Bratislava. We make turnkey custom kitchens for apartments, new builds, and private houses: measurement, design, 3D visualization, technical design, manufacturing, delivery, installation, and the fitting of appliances. Everything is done in-house, with no intermediaries.

You can choose one of the 32 models in our catalog and adapt it to your kitchen, or order a bespoke design. We take particular care with open-plan kitchen and living rooms, where the kitchen furniture becomes part of the overall interior.

blocks.title: Kitchens in Bratislava
rows: our own team, included in the price

items: Site measurement with the positions of utilities, windows, doors, and appliances.
Design and layout — straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, with an island or peninsula, built in up to the ceiling, or an open-plan kitchen and living area.
3D visualization — the color of the fronts, the countertop, the backsplash, lighting, and appliances in your interior before production starts.
Technical design — cabinet drawings, a connection diagram, and a specification of materials and hardware.
Manufacturing at our own production facility in Bratislava.
Delivery and installation, with adjustment of the fronts and mechanisms.
Fitting of appliances — oven, cooktop, range hood, dishwasher, refrigerator. Miele appliances can be supplied on request.

parts.html: Fronts: laminated chipboard, foil-wrapped MDF, painted MDF, veneer, HPL, acrylic, glass. Countertops: laminate, compact laminate, engineered quartz, porcelain stoneware, acrylic stone, and natural stone. Hettich, Blum, and Häfele hardware: soft-close mechanisms, pull-out systems, lift-up mechanisms, cargo pull-outs, interior organizers, and waste sorting systems.
The configuration is tailored to your requirements and budget — from standard to premium. Samples of fronts, countertops, and hardware can be viewed at the studio.

blocks.text: How to order a kitchen in Bratislava

items: Inquiry. Send us a floor plan or the dimensions of your kitchen, photos, and examples of designs you like — or choose a model from the catalog.
Preliminary quote. Within a few days, we give you an approximate price.
Measurement and design. We visit the property, develop the design and 3D visualization, and agree on the materials and appliances.
Final price and contract. One amount for the kitchen, including delivery and installation.
Production and installation. We manufacture, deliver, install, and fit the appliances.

blocks.text: Questions about custom kitchens in Bratislava

items.q: How much does a custom kitchen cost in Bratislava?
items.a: The price depends on the length and configuration, the materials of the fronts and countertop, the hardware, and the appliances. We give you the exact price after the measurement and design — as one amount including delivery and installation. For a guide to model prices, see the catalog.

items.q: How long does it take to make a kitchen?
items.a: The lead time depends on the scope, materials, and current production workload — we confirm it with the quote. It starts once the design is approved and the deposit is paid.

items.q: Can a catalog model be modified?
items.a: Yes. The dimensions, front color, countertop, interior fittings, and appliances are tailored to your kitchen — the model serves as a starting point.
During installation, we install and fit the appliances. Water, gas, and electrical connections are part of the renovation work — if our crew is doing the renovation, it is all handled as one project.

items.q: Do you make kitchens for Vienna?
items.a: Yes, with delivery and installation by our own crew; delivery is included in the price. Learn more: custom kitchens in Vienna.
Yes, at the studio at Súkennícka 1 by appointment: fronts, countertops, hardware, and examples of completed kitchens.
